brief.headline: Renewed Europe junior at 100% of the layer.
brief.body: US Southeast is 54% of the book, Europe 46%. The second Atlantic peril has to clear a higher hurdle because Florida and the Gulf co-move (measured annual-loss correlation +0.42). Europe is the genuine diversifier (cross-region correlation ~0). That is why idle capital went there rather than back into Florida or the Gulf. Highest standing score is Europe senior at 0.14 (rate on line 2.6% vs expected loss 0.8%, divided by √EL so juniors are not favoured on raw margin). Florida senior scores 0.12 but was not added: it is off-risk this term. The rule does not move. Caps, attachment points and the scoring formula were fixed before the run. The agent only chooses the line inside them.
